grammar.summary: 本课围绕打捞馅饼盘子的趣事，集中运用了 so...that 结果状语从句、被动语态以及 now that/so that 引导的目的与原因状语从句，叙事中大量出现 prove to be 结构来表达「结果证明为……」。

points.title: so...that 结果状语从句 (Result Clause)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句表示「如此……以至于……」。本课用 so smooth that 描述盘子表面光滑难以拴绳，用 such force that 描写水流冲击掀起大浪，凸显打捞工作的困难。

examples.en: The sides of the dish were so smooth that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it.
examples.cn: 盘子四边十分光滑，要在盘边拴上绳索或链条而同时又不损坏它是很难办到的。

examples.en: Water streamed in torrents over its sides with such force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.
examples.cn: 波浪从盘子两侧急涌而出，在运河里掀起一股大浪。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 被动语态 be + 过去分词突出受事者。本课叙述盘子被打捞、被固定、被拽上岸的过程，主语多为「盘子」本身，强调它被施加的各种动作，使叙事以物体为中心层层推进。

examples.en: It had been purchased by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
examples.cn: 某地方当局买下它用来焙制一个巨大的馅饼为一年一度交易会助兴。

examples.en: Eventually chains were fixed to one end of the dish and a powerful winch was put into operation.
examples.cn: 不过，他们终于将链条固定在盘子的一端，一台大功率的绞车开动起来。

examples.en: The dish rose to the surface and was gently drawn towards the canal bank.
examples.cn: 盘子慢慢浮出水面，被轻轻地拽向运河岸边。

points.title: prove to be 结构 (Prove to be)
points.explanation: prove to be + 名词/形容词意为「结果是、证明是」，用于表达事情发展后显现出的真实情况。本课多次使用该结构，交代跳舞导致翻盘、打捞遭遇困难等结果，推动情节转折。

examples.en: Dancing proved to be more than the dish could bear, for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
examples.cn: 他们跳起了舞，盘子难以承受。舞会进行过程中，盘子倾覆，沉入了7英尺深的水中。

examples.en: They had little difficulty in finding it, but hauling it out of the water proved to be a serious problem.
examples.cn: 他们没费多大事儿就找到了盘子。可是把盘子捞出却是一个很大的难题。

exercises.q: The sides of the dish were ______ smooth that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it.
It had been ______ by a local authority so that an enormous pie could be baked for an annual fair.
Dancing ______ to be more than the dish could bear, for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water.
用 so...that 结构填空：Water streamed in torrents over its sides with ______ force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.（填入与 such 搭配的修饰词，此处修饰名词 force）
下列哪个词与课文中 capsized 的含义最接近？
